newsitem.title: USA: ValueVision Q3 sales double after purchase.
newsitem.headline: ValueVision Q3 sales double after purchase.

text.p: ValueVision International Inc said on Tuesday its purchase of Montgomery Ward Direct in August helped sales more than double in the third quarter ended October 31.

Net sales reached $47 million, compared to $22 million in the third quarter of fiscal 1995, ValueVision said. The company said nearly all of its direct-marketing revenue came from catalog sales by the Montgomery Ward Direct division.

ValueVision, a television home-shopping concern, reported net income fell to $608,736 from $8.1 million in the year-earlier period. The 1995 figure included a $8.5 million gain from the sale of its National Media Corp stake.
